title: What If the Moon Disappeared?
habit: Without the Moon, nights go dark, tides shrink and Earth's tilt is less steady.

shots.say: What if the Moon disappeared tonight?
First, nights would get much darker. No moonlight, ever.
Then the oceans change. The Moon drives most of our tides.
With only the Sun, tides would be about a third as strong.
Over millions of years, Earth's tilt could drift more. Scientists still debate how much.
So the Moon isn't just pretty. It helps keep our world steady.

pt.description: E se a Lua desaparecesse esta noite? Noites mais escuras, marés cerca de três vezes mais fracas e uma inclinação da Terra menos estável ao longo de milhões de anos.
